stage_mapping: Epoch = original stage - 6; numerical indices match current main Figure 4 G.
epoch_definition: Search-round index; each round contains multiple parameter configurations.

error_definitions.rank_error: Mean absolute model-patient difference in conditional participating normalized mean ranks, averaged equally across SCL and ICL.
error_definitions.within_rod_order_error: Mean absolute model-patient difference in within-shaft co-participating pair precedence probabilities, averaged equally across SCL and ICL.
error_definitions.participation_error: Mean absolute model-patient difference in contact participation probabilities, averaged equally across SCL and ICL.

statistical_unit: Each profile is one parameter configuration, evaluated on its eligible-event distribution from a fixed 60-s simulation.
search_stage_meaning: Historical search rounds; one round contains multiple parameter evaluations, not one epoch per profile.
interpretation: Both rows show the same 194-configuration evaluation pool. Only the thick black profile and open circles correspond to the propagation examples in that row.
optimizer_objective: Evaluation errors are the historical descriptive metrics, distinct from the training loss shown in main Figure 4.
